extracted.intended_audience: writers seeking traditional publication, especially authors without agents (unagented submissions)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors who want to submit manuscripts directly to Pan Macmillan Australia (no agent required): what genres the publisher favors or excludes, what materials to prepare, how to submit, and expected reading timeline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance of unagented electronic submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Pan Macmillan Australia is accepting electronic manuscript submissions directly from writers - no agent needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pan Macmillan is a major Australian publisher with a wide range of imprints (Macmillan, Pan, Picador, Plum, Momentum, Macquarie Dictionary Publishers, Pancake, St Martin's Press, Tor, Forge, Griffin and Sidgwick & Jackson). Authors may submit directly without an agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres generally not published
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not generally publish poetry, plays or textbooks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although they say they are happy to receive any genre of manuscript, poetry, plays and textbooks are specifically noted as genres they do not generally publish — submit with that expectation in mind.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiction interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction: Contemporary drama, sagas, psychological suspense, crime and thrillers, historical, literary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the fiction subgenres Pan Macmillan states it is particularly interested in; submissions in other fiction subgenres may be less likely to fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-fiction interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-fiction: Narrative non-fiction, contemporary issues, memoir, history, true crime, lifestyle and health, mind body spirit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pan Macmillan lists these non-fiction categories as of interest — tailor proposals and sample pages to show fit with these areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Children’s & young adult interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Children’s books & young adult fiction: Junior and middle grade fiction, young adult/crossover fiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you write for younger readers, ensure your submission targets junior/middle grade or YA/crossover markets as indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher subject scope / imprints
rubrics_metrics.description: Pan Macmillan publishes commercial and literary fiction, children's and YA fiction, picture books, Australiana, history, biographies, cooking, health and self-help, sports and travel; it also handles sales for Guinness World Records.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This list describes the broad subject areas and imprints the publisher works in — use it to judge whether your book’s category matches their program and imprint priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials required for submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare the first 50 pages of your novel or non-fiction proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For novels, include the first 50 pages; for non-fiction, have a proposal ready. This is the specific sample material the publisher requests to assess a manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method and timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Fill out the submissions form at https://www.panmacmillan.com.au/submissions/; your manuscript will be read within three months of the date we receive it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit electronically through the publisher’s online submissions form. Expect a reading/response period of up to three months; plan follow-up or simultaneous submissions accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advice to check publisher catalogue for fit
rubrics_metrics.description: Please review our catalogue to find out what kind of books we publish. This is also a great opportunity to discover authors and titles similar to yours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before submitting, compare your book to the publisher’s existing catalogue and authors to ensure good fit — submissions that align with the publisher’s list are more likely to be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other publishers accepting unagented submissions (example)
rubrics_metrics.description: Allen & Unwin also accepts submissions directly from writers - no agent needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The post notes other publishers that accept unagented submissions; authors seeking direct submission options can research multiple houses that allow unsolicited manuscripts.
